observations.title: Hear rain on different surfaces
observations.player_action: Stand near rain falling on glass, water, lava/magma, foliage, metal or wool.
observations.outcome: The sound changes with nearby blocks and distance from the surface.
conditions: Installed 1.0.3 predates the page's explicitly 1.4.0 storm wind/thunder additions; those additions are not confirmed here.
